svg.title: Agrifarm Database Architecture ERD
svg.desc: Grouped database architecture diagram showing primary key to foreign key relationships generated from the Prisma schema.
svg.text: Grouped by business domain. Table rows show key primary, foreign, and unique fields. Relationship lines represent every Prisma @relation field mapping.

g.text: [PK] primary key [FK] foreign key [UK] unique key Arrow points to the dependent table
